occupations.title: Project Management Specialists
occupations.rationale: The product is explicitly described as a "work and project management application" with features for organizing projects, tracking tasks, and managing deadlines to provide a "live view of the whole project" ([D:Asana:landing:4], [D:Asana:features:2]).

occupations.title: Marketing Managers
occupations.rationale: The excerpts explicitly mention marketing teams as users who track their part of a project, such as a product launch, within the application ([D:Asana:landing:3]).

occupations.title: General and Operations Managers
occupations.rationale: The product is positioned as an "operating system" for running an organization's critical workflows and is used by "ops" teams to track their work, which aligns with the responsibilities of operations managers ([D:Asana:features:1], [D:Asana:landing:3]).
